text:
Situation: Esmolol hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 214 vials of the 100 mg/10 mL presentation at 10.7 vials per day, providing 19.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds 386 vials at 13.9 vials per day, providing 27.8 days on hand. Our current label names Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as the repack plant (FEI 3014288534).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1249077 at Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC ended on 2024-09-11 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2024-11-15. The product is not listed on the FDA shortage list.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 20 to 28 days across sites. No national shortage is declared. The prior VAI inspection at the repack plant warrants monitoring but does not currently disrupt supply. Secondary manufacturers (Baxter Healthcare Company, Baxter Healthcare Corporation) are also not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue purchasing from current contracted suppliers; buyer executes, pharmacy director approves.
2. Qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Baxter Healthcare Company, Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as backup sources; buyer executes, pharmacy director approves, P&T committee approves formulary additions.
3. Track daily usage and update days-on-hand weekly; buyer executes, pharmacy director reviews.
4. Request plant identification from backup manufacturers' labels; buyer executes.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or clinical protocol changes at this time.
